chunks: He said: Abul Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me from his father, from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, peace be upon them both, who said:
"Islam has been built upon five pillars: the establishment of prayer, giving of zakat, fasting in the month of Ramadan, pilgrimage to the Sacred House, and the Wilayah to us, the Ahl al-Bayt."

key_terms.أهل البيت: The People of the House - the Prophet's household
key_terms.الولاية: Wilayah - guardianship, authority, and devotion to the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.دعائم: Pillars or foundations upon which Islam rests

ai.seo_question: What are the five pillars of Islam according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam Muhammad al-Baqir (AS) enumerates the five foundational pillars of Islam in the Shia tradition: prayer, zakat, fasting, hajj, and wilayah (devotion/allegiance) to the Ahl al-Bayt. This hadith is significant because it includes wilayah as one of the fundamental pillars, distinguishing the Shia understanding of Islamic foundations from other schools.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
